line: Summertime, was on the block pullin’ bitches with Marvin (Cap) Next thing, he put on hoodies with Slick and went robbin’
vault_lines: Next thing, he put on hoodies with Slick and went robbin'
meaning:
G Herbo is talking about his fallen friend Capo, real name, Marvin Carr who was shot and killed in drive by shooting on July 11, 2015.



He also talking about Capo’s nephew T-Slick who has been incarcerated since 2012. He is expected to be released in 2022 or 2023.
